app.name: Handsfree
app.tagline: Browse the web with your webcam and voice.
onboarding.title: Welcome to Handsfree
onboarding.step.permissions.heading: Camera and Microphone
onboarding.step.permissions.body: Handsfree uses your camera to move the cursor and your microphone for voice commands. Video never leaves your device.
onboarding.step.calibration.heading: Quick Calibration
onboarding.step.calibration.body: Pop the bubbles with your head movement. Takes about 30 seconds.
onboarding.step.nod.heading: Nod to Select
onboarding.step.nod.body: Hover over a target, then nod your head to click.
onboarding.step.voice.heading: Try Voice Commands
onboarding.step.voice.body: Say "scroll down" to test your microphone.
onboarding.step.ritual.heading: Create a Ritual
onboarding.step.ritual.body: Record a sequence of steps triggered by a phrase.
onboarding.step.done.heading: You're ready!
onboarding.step.done.body: Handsfree is active. Say "pause listening" to pause at any time.
settings.title: Handsfree Settings
privacy.notice: Your camera feed never leaves your device. Voice commands in standard mode use your browser's speech engine, which may send audio to {{vendor}}. Enable Private mode for fully offline recognition.
benchmark.title: Performance Benchmark
error.camera_denied: Camera access was denied. Please allow it in browser settings.
error.mic_denied: Microphone access was denied. Please allow it in browser settings.
error.tracking_failed: Tracking failed to start. Try reloading the extension.
error.ritual_step_failed: A ritual step could not find its target element.
